description: This file provides functions and classes for interacting with the Discord API, including error parsing, retry logic, and a fetch wrapper with retry capabilities.

classes.name: DiscordApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling Discord API errors, including status and optional retry-after information.

methods.name: parseDiscordApiErrorPayload
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to extract Discord API error payload information.

methods.name: parseRetryAfterSeconds
methods.description: Extracts the retry-after seconds from error payload or response headers.

methods.name: formatRetryAfterSeconds
methods.description: Formats a number of seconds into a string with 's' suffix, rounded appropriately.

methods.name: formatDiscordApiErrorText
methods.description: Formats error text from Discord API responses into user-friendly messages.

methods.name: fetchDiscord
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to Discord API with automatic retries on rate limiting errors.
